'''Coronet Nova Steakhouse''' was a high-end restaurant located within the [[Core District/Legends|Core District]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]]. Like many of the attractions within the Core District, the restaurant's architecture represented a specific [[Planet/Legends|planet]] within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]; specifically [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The Nova specialized in food and drink from [[Coronet City]], the capital of Corellia.
